notes: SR52 Williams Sonoma Home. Site's mega-nav has one 'New' item (canonical URL /shop/home-new/, which itself resolves to /shop/home-new/home-all-new/ per the page's own canonicalUrl/categoryId - the site's 'All New Arrivals' roll-up) with genuine department children exposed both under /shop/home-new/home-new-<dept>/ and, for at least Furniture and Decor, re-aliased under /shop/home-<dept>/wsh-<dept>-new-arrivals/ (confirmed identical: same page <title>, same Constructor.io categoryId/group_id, same rendered item count - kept the /shop/home-new/... form as canonical and did not double-list the alias). METHOD: qty for 3 pages (All New=135, New Furniture=40, New Decor=21) was read directly off the live WebKit-rendered page header text ('135 Items' / '40 Items' / '21 Items') and cross-checked exact-match against the site's own Constructor.io browse API (ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<slug>, key_PysinTjKriGSD1Zl) - the literal endpoint the page's own JS calls, captured via live network trace. All 3 matched exactly with zero discrepancy. Midway through the session Akamai began rate-limiting/blocking further direct requests to williams-sonoma.com (both curl_cffi and Playwright WebKit, which had both been working), so the remaining rows below rely on that same Constructor.io browse API only, without a second live-header cross-check; group_id was independently confirmed via each page's own embedded categoryId (fetched over HTTP before the block) for New Outdoor/Bedding/Rugs, and via the URL-slug=group_id naming pattern (which held for every page checked this session) for New Lighting/Pillows&Throws and the two Morris & Co. collab pages. New Bath's URL was not in the shop-sitemap dump under /shop/home-new/ - the sitemap-confirmed URL is /shop/home-bath/wsh-bath-new-arrivals/ (department-level alias, matching the Furniture/Decor alias pattern above); its group_id 'home-new-bath' was pattern-guessed and returned a valid small result set (3) but could not be independently confirmed against that specific URL before the block, so it carries the heaviest flag of the set. The two Morris & Co. x Williams Sonoma Home collaboration pages are genuine product listings (dinnerware/flatware/napkins; bedroom furniture) but sit at the boundary between 'New Arrivals' and the site's separate 'Collaborations' nav item, so both are flagged per brief Sec.3 ambiguous-collection guidance rather than silently included or excluded. No Clearance/Sale overlap issue here - New/Sale are separate trees.
